free_tier.stated: up to 256 GB per single uploaded file; no per-account total published on the page read

egress.terms: Free to viewers. Playback is served from VK's own streaming CDN, no per-GB charge to the uploader.

record.tooling: yt-dlp VK extractor (yt_dlp/extractor/vk.py) for retrieval; VK API video.save / video upload for pushing files
record.chaining: Per-upload limit is 256 GB with unlimited video uploads per account, allowing dataset distribution across discrete video files on a single identity.
record.limits_note: 256 GB single file; video must be a real playable video container (arbitrary bytes only survive if 'original file download' is enabled by the uploader); retrieval goes through the player/extractor path
record.reliability_note: Uploaded media may be transcoded; non-video payloads die on transcode; VK periodically changes the playback protocol and breaks yt-dlp (yt-dlp issues 16070/11715 track exactly this churn), and content can be removed for complaints.
